connector.name: Appcircle MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Appcircle mobile CI/CD platform.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.appcircle.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.appcircle. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Appcircle Access Token — format: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN
